a) DC kesma uzunligini toping.
b) AB va AC tomonlari ayirmasi modulini toping. [Rasm tavsifi: Geometrik chizmada ichki chizilgan aylanaga ega yirik ABC uchburchagi tasvirlangan. Aylananing markazi O nuqta deb belgilangan. O nuqtadan o'tuvchi va uchburchakning pastki BC asosiga parallel bo'lgan EF kesmasi o'tkazilgan (bunda E nuqta AB tomonda, F nuqta esa AC tomonda yotadi). Chizmada EB kesmasi yoniga 8 raqami va FC kesmasi yoniga 12 raqami yozilgan. Shuningdek, A uchidan chiqib BC tomonini D nuqtada kesib o'tuvchi AD bissektrisasi chizilgan va u ham ichki chizilgan aylananing markazi O nuqtadan o'tishi ko'rsatilgan].

42. ABCD kvadrat ichidan P nuqta olingan. Agar AP = 1, BP = 5, PC = 7 bo’lsa:
a) PD kesma uzunligini toping.
b) Kvadratning yuzini toping. [Rasm tavsifi: Tekislikda standart ABCD kvadrati chizilgan. Kvadratning ichki qismida ixtiyoriy P nuqta tanlangan. Bu P nuqtadan kvadratning to'rtta uchigacha to'g'ri chiziqli kesmalar o'tkazilgan: AP kesmasi uzunligi 1, BP kesmasi uzunligi 5 va PC kesmasi uzunligi 7 ekanligi chizmadagi tegishli chiziqlar yonida raqamlar bilan ko'rsatilgan. P nuqtadan D uchigacha bo'lgan PD kesmasi ham tutashtirilgan bo'lib, uning qiymatini topish talab etiladi].

Parallelogram ABCD ga qarang. Nuqtalar A(0,0), B(b,0), D(0,d) va C(b,d) koordinatalarda joylashgan. Nuqtа E AB tomonida joylashgan bo‘lib, AE:EB = 2:3 ga teng. E nuqtadan AD ga parallel chiziq chiziladi; bu chiziq diagonal AC bilan G nuqtasida kesishadi. EGCD to‘rtburchakning yuzasi va butun parallelogram ABCD ning yuzalari orasidagi nisbatni toping. Agar <triangle> ABD ning yuzasi 150 bo‘lsa, EGCD ning yuzasini hisoblang.
questions.pic_about: A parallelogram ABCD is drawn with vertex A at the origin (0,0), vertex B at (b,0) on the x‑axis, vertex D at (0,d) on the y‑axis, and vertex C at (b,d). Side AB is horizontal, AD is vertical, and BC is vertical while CD is horizontal, making ABCD a rectangle‑shaped parallelogram. Point E lies on side AB such that the segment AE is two‑fifths of AB and EB is three‑fifths of AB; therefore E has coordinates (2b/5,0). From E a line is drawn parallel to AD, i.e., a vertical line x = 2b/5. This vertical line meets the diagonal AC (the line from (0,0) to (b,d)) at point G. Because AC has equation y = (d/b)x, the intersection point G is at (2b/5, 2d/5). The quadrilateral EGCD is formed by connecting the points in order E → G → C → D → E. The diagram therefore shows a vertical segment EG inside the parallelogram, the top side CD, and the left side AD, with point G located on the diagonal AC.
questions.sub_a: a) EGCD ning yuzasining ABCD ga nisbati.
questions.sub_b: b) S_{ABD}=150 bo‘lganda, EGCD ning yuzasini toping.
